RID-MULTI8-LAB-R4
# PR #213: bounded 8-contact Remote ID assembler with concurrency fix.
# R4: update emulator's real Remote ID decoder adapter to the new API.
# R3: BLE names use an atomic per-MAC snapshot; enumerate live contacts
# densely even when one middle slot has expired. Host test covers holes.
# BLE NimBLE host callbacks and Wi-Fi queue loop share an RTOS critical section.
# Read-only contact diagnostics return copies under same lock; no live pointers.
# Track key is (MAC, transport), 30-second TTL, fixed ring of 8 contacts.
# Host vectors test interleaved drones, MAC/transport separation, expiry,
# oldest eviction, malformed frames and 32-bit millis wraparound.
# Correct 0x1F0000 OTA partition per slot; independent PR Build must PASS
# before this release may build and Pages can deploy.
# CYD 2.8 ST7789 and 3.2 ST7798 hardware acceptance still required.
# No merge, tag or production release; preserve all other branches.
